description: Six fixed local-repository development tasks for a configured live provider. This is a development set, not a public leaderboard.

tasks.prompt: Fix app/calculator.py so add returns the sum. Inspect before editing and verify the behavior.
tasks.verifier: python -c "from app.calculator import add; assert add(2,3)==5; assert add(-1,1)==0"

tasks.prompt: Fix clamp in app/calculator.py so values are constrained to inclusive low/high bounds. Verify edge cases.
tasks.verifier: python -c "from app.calculator import clamp; assert clamp(-1,0,10)==0; assert clamp(11,0,10)==10; assert clamp(5,0,10)==5"

tasks.prompt: Fix app/client.py so connect_timeout follows the shared DEFAULT_TIMEOUT configuration.
tasks.verifier: python -c "from app.client import connect_timeout; assert connect_timeout()==30"

tasks.prompt: Fix normalize_name and slugify in app/text.py according to their docstrings. Verify multiple inputs.
tasks.verifier: python -c "from app.text import normalize_name,slugify; assert normalize_name(' A ')=='a'; assert slugify('Hello World')=='hello-world'"

tasks.prompt: Fix parse_port and split_pair in app/parser.py according to their docstrings.
tasks.verifier: python -c "from app.parser import parse_port,split_pair; assert parse_port('80')==80; assert split_pair('a=b')==('a','b')"

tasks.prompt: Fix retry_count and users_endpoint in app/service.py to use the imported shared configuration values.
tasks.verifier: python -c "from app.service import retry_count,users_endpoint; assert retry_count()==3; assert users_endpoint()=='/v1/users'"
